276147198.description:
This listing includes an assortment of small Herkimer and Pakimer quartz diamond mineral specimens. The crystals range in size from approximately 3mm to 15mm, with the largest crystal about the size of a US penny. The total weight of the set is 1.9 grams as measured on a digital scale. The crystals are characterized by their clear to slightly cloudy appearance, double-terminated shape, and natural inclusions, including a notable black inclusion in the largest specimen. These quartz diamonds are natural, uncut, and show no signs of artificial polishing or enhancement. Suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or use in jewelry making. A few show UV reaction, coin is for scale not part of sale.

*Grab bags /Assortments come as is with no refunds or returns.

276132719.description:
A.T. Cross Company
Double Desk Set with "Da Boss" Engraved Nameplate
10KT Gold Filled Writing Instruments on Wood Base
Base: 11" x 3" x 1"
Hallmarked 1/20 10KT Gold Filled USA
This professional desk set represents the classic mid-century executive aesthetic, featuring two slender writing instruments in a 10KT gold-filled finish. The set is anchored by a polished wood base with a warm burgundy finish, accented by a gold-tone nameplate engraved with "Da Boss." Each instrument is housed in a swiveling black acrylic holder, allowing for ergonomic positioning and sleek visual lines characteristic of A.T. Cross design heritage.
Writing instruments hallmarked 1/20 10KT G.F. CROSS MADE IN USA on upper barrels
Polished wood base features a protective felt bottom with embossed Cross logo
Includes original black presentation box with historical gold-foil Cross branding
Set includes one ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil in matching gold-filled finish
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with the gold-filled surfaces retaining high luster and minimal surface micro-scratching. The wood base is structurally sound with a clean finish and minor shelf wear to the felt underside. The presentation box shows light external storage wear but remains intact and functional.
